Recommended Gems

It is important that in one socket you are always using either Telluric Eversong Diamond or Indecipherable Eversong Diamond. Telluric will provide a bit more mana at the cost of some primary stat. Overall the difference is very minor and you can typically run what you feel comfortable with, or simply socket the cheaper option.

In Mythic+ you may value the mana less because you can drink in between pulls, while in Raid the extra mana can be valuable when you are struggling on a fight. To conserve your gold, you may want to start out with the maximum Mana gem, until you notice yourself never running oom on a fight, at which point you can switch for a tiny bit more throughput.

When using Telluric Eversong Diamond, you will want to have as many different color gems in your gear as possible. This means you should be using one of each of the following:

  • Flawless Quick Amethyst
  • Flawless Masterful Garnet
  • Flawless Masterful Peridot
  • Flawless Masterful Lapis

With the remaining gem sockets, or when using Indecipherable Eversong Diamond, you will want to use Flawless Quick Amethyst. That being said, you should continue to consult with QuestionablyEpic to truly optimize your gems.

Best Enchants and Weapon Augments

The best Weapon Oil for Holy Paladin will be Thalassian Phoenix Oil. The secondary stat boosts provides a nice bonus in every form of content and the alternative Oil of Dawn is not strong enough to ever be worth using. When playing Lightsmith, you will not need a weapon oil as Rite of Sanctification will instead be used.

3.

Optimal Consumables

Consumables such as Flasks, Food, Potions, even Oils can increase your power by a noticeable margin and are worth utilizing anytime you are doing challenging content. If gold isn't a concern, you can choose to always use them!

3.1.

Flask

Flask of the Magisters will be your go-to choice for maximizing your healing output. In situations like Mythic+, where you do not need extra healing, you can instead choose to run Flask of the Blood Knights or Flask of the Shattered Sun.

3.2.

Potions

There are two potions that are worth considering in Midnight: Potion of Recklessness and Lightfused Mana Potion. It is important to note that these potions share cooldowns. Using one of them will put all others on cooldown. In any situation where mana is concerned, you should be using Lightfused Mana Potion only. When you do not need the mana you can instead use Potion of Recklessness alongside your major cooldowns.

Make sure to always keep Concentrated Silvermoon Health Potions on you at all times. These potions do not share a cooldown with combat/mana potions meaning that you can use them whenever you are in need of emergency healing to yourself.

3.3.

Food Buff

You should be eating Hearty Silvermoon Parade as the desired feast or Hearty Royal Roast for your own personal food. These provide you with an increase to your primary stat and that beats out any other food choices.
